+"""Immutable CPU metadata from one native model forward."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+from sglang_simulator.time_predictor.base import (
+    PredictorError,
+    ScheduleBatch,
+    ScheduleRequest,
+)
+
+SNAPSHOT_ATTRIBUTE = "_sglang_simulator_prepared_batch"
+
+
+def _cpu_int(value, *, field):
+    device = getattr(value, "device", None)
+    if device is not None:
+        if getattr(device, "type", None) != "cpu":
+            raise PredictorError("invalid_batch", f"{field} must be on CPU")
+        if getattr(value, "ndim", None) != 0:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "invalid_batch", f"{field} must contain scalar integers"
+            )
+        value = value.item()
+    if type(value) is not int:
+        raise PredictorError("invalid_batch", f"{field} must contain integers")
+    return value
+
+
+def _cpu_lengths(batch, field, batch_size):
+    values = getattr(batch, field, None)
+    if values is None:
+        raise PredictorError("invalid_batch", f"prepared forward is missing {field}")
+    device = getattr(values, "device", None)
+    if device is not None:
+        if getattr(device, "type", None) != "cpu":
+            raise PredictorError("invalid_batch", f"{field} must be on CPU")
+        if getattr(values, "ndim", None) != 1:
+            raise PredictorError("invalid_batch", f"{field} must be one-dimensional")
+    elif not isinstance(values, (list, tuple)):
+        raise PredictorError("invalid_batch", f"{field} must be a CPU vector")
+    if len(values) != batch_size:
+        raise PredictorError(
+            "invalid_batch",
+            f"{field} must match the prepared batch size",
+            batch_size=batch_size,
+            length=len(values),
+        )
+    return tuple(_cpu_int(value, field=field) for value in values)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PreparedBatchSnapshot:
+    forward_mode: str
+    seq_lens_cpu: tuple[int, ...]
+    extend_seq_lens_cpu: tuple[int, ...] | None = None
+    extend_prefix_lens_cpu: tuple[int, ...] | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        if self.forward_mode not in {"EXTEND", "MIXED", "DECODE"}:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "unsupported_forward_mode",
+                f"unsupported SGLang forward mode {self.forward_mode!r}",
+                forward_mode=self.forward_mode,
+            )
+        if (
+            type(self.seq_lens_cpu) is not tuple
+            or not self.seq_lens_cpu
+            or any(
+                type(length) is not int or length < 1 for length in self.seq_lens_cpu
+            )
+        ):
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "invalid_batch", "prepared sequence lengths must be positive"
+            )
+        if self.forward_mode == "DECODE":
+            if (
+                self.extend_seq_lens_cpu is not None
+                or self.extend_prefix_lens_cpu is not None
+            ):
+                raise PredictorError(
+                    "invalid_batch", "decode snapshot must not contain extend lengths"
+                )
+            return
+        for field in ("extend_seq_lens_cpu", "extend_prefix_lens_cpu"):
+            lengths = getattr(self, field)
+            minimum = 1 if field == "extend_seq_lens_cpu" else 0
+            if (
+                type(lengths) is not tuple
+                or len(lengths) != len(self.seq_lens_cpu)
+                or any(
+                    type(length) is not int or length < minimum for length in lengths
+                )
+            ):
+                raise PredictorError("invalid_batch", f"invalid prepared {field}")
+        if any(
+            sequence != prefix + extend
+            for sequence, prefix, extend in zip(
+                self.seq_lens_cpu,
+                self.extend_prefix_lens_cpu,
+                self.extend_seq_lens_cpu,
+            )
+        ):
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "invalid_batch",
+                "prepared sequence length must equal prefix plus extend",
+            )
+
+    def predictor_batch(self, *, expected_batch_size=None):
+        if expected_batch_size is not None and expected_batch_size != len(
+            self.seq_lens_cpu
+        ):
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "invalid_batch",
+                "prepared snapshot does not match the result batch size",
+            )
+        if self.forward_mode == "DECODE":
+            requests = [
+                ScheduleRequest(extend_length=1, past_kv_length=sequence - 1)
+                for sequence in self.seq_lens_cpu
+            ]
+        else:
+            requests = [
+                ScheduleRequest(extend_length=extend, past_kv_length=prefix)
+                for extend, prefix in zip(
+                    self.extend_seq_lens_cpu, self.extend_prefix_lens_cpu
+                )
+            ]
+        return ScheduleBatch(reqs=requests, forward_mode=self.forward_mode)
+
+
+def capture_prepared_batch(batch):
+    """Copy CPU mirrors before model execution; never synchronize device metadata."""
+    mode = getattr(getattr(batch, "forward_mode", None), "name", None)
+    if mode not in {"EXTEND", "MIXED", "DECODE"}:
+        raise PredictorError(
+            "unsupported_forward_mode",
+            f"unsupported SGLang forward mode {mode!r}",
+            forward_mode=mode,
+        )
+    batch_size = getattr(batch, "batch_size", None)
+    if type(batch_size) is not int or batch_size < 1:
+        raise PredictorError("invalid_batch", "prepared batch size must be positive")
+    sequence_lengths = _cpu_lengths(batch, "seq_lens_cpu", batch_size)
+    if mode == "DECODE":
+        return PreparedBatchSnapshot(mode, sequence_lengths)
+    return PreparedBatchSnapshot(
+        mode,
+        sequence_lengths,
+        _cpu_lengths(batch, "extend_seq_lens_cpu", batch_size),
+        _cpu_lengths(batch, "extend_prefix_lens_cpu", batch_size),
+    )
+
+
+def predictor_batch_from_result(result, *, expected_batch_size):
+    snapshot = getattr(getattr(result, "logits_output", None), SNAPSHOT_ATTRIBUTE, None)
+    if not isinstance(snapshot, PreparedBatchSnapshot):
+        raise PredictorError(
+            "invalid_batch", "model result is missing a valid prepared snapshot"
+        )
+    return snapshot.predictor_batch(expected_batch_size=expected_batch_size)

+"""Bind native controller spawning to the simulator's early child bootstrap."""
+
+from importlib import import_module
+
+from sglang_simulator.compat import SGLangCompatibilityError
+
+
+def install_controller_process_entry() -> None:
+    """Patch only the opt-in parent's Engine alias, retaining the native callee.
+
+    Native Engine does not expose a controller entry-point argument like its
+    scheduler/detokenizer arguments. Its module-level alias is the actual spawn
+    target. The wrapper lives in hook_bootstrap so unpickling that target also
+    prepares compatibility before native launch arguments are unpickled.
+    """
+    engine = import_module("sglang.srt.entrypoints.engine")
+    bootstrap = import_module("sglang_simulator.simulation.sglang.hook_bootstrap")
+    wrapper = bootstrap.run_simulator_data_parallel_controller_process
+    current = getattr(engine, "run_data_parallel_controller_process", None)
+    if current is wrapper:
+        return
+    controller = import_module("sglang.srt.managers.data_parallel_controller")
+    native = getattr(controller, "run_data_parallel_controller_process", None)
+    if not callable(native) or current is not native:
+        raise SGLangCompatibilityError(
+            "SGLang Simulator requires Engine's native data-parallel controller "
+            "spawn alias; an absent or replaced entry point cannot be adapted"
+        )
+    engine.run_data_parallel_controller_process = wrapper

+"""Constant-size virtual timing snapshots carried by native response metadata."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from functools import wraps
+
+import msgspec
+from sglang_simulator.hook import BaseHook
+from sglang_simulator.simulation.coordinator import Coordinator, ProtocolError
+from sglang_simulator.simulation.sglang.token_events import TokenEventRecorder
+
+METADATA_KEY = "sglang_simulator"
+_REQUEST_ATTRIBUTE = "_simulator_timing"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class TimingMetadataOutput:
+    """Host auxiliary output, consumed after native visible-token commits."""
+
+    clock: Coordinator
+    commit_ns: int
+    previous: object = None
+    token_events: TokenEventRecorder | None = None
+
+    def consume(self, batch, commits) -> None:
+        if self.previous is not None:
+            self.previous.consume(batch, commits)
+        output_events = []
+        for req, commit in zip(batch.reqs, commits, strict=True):
+            prior = getattr(req, _REQUEST_ATTRIBUTE, None)
+            count = prior["completion_tokens"] if prior is not None else 0
+            first_ns = prior["first_token_ns"] if prior is not None else None
+            last_ns = prior["last_token_ns"] if prior is not None else None
+            # Native abort cleanup can append a running batch's result after
+            # the protocol cancellation. That discarded tail is not output.
+            if commit is not None and not self.clock.is_cancelled(req.rid):
+                if commit.output_index != count:
+                    raise ProtocolError(f"non-contiguous token commit for {req.rid}")
+                count += len(commit.token_ids)
+                if commit.token_ids:
+                    if self.token_events is not None:
+                        output_events.append(
+                            (req.rid, commit.output_index, len(commit.token_ids))
+                        )
+                    if first_ns is None:
+                        first_ns = self.commit_ns
+                    last_ns = self.commit_ns
+            snapshot = {
+                "version": 1,
+                "rid": req.rid,
+                "arrival_ns": self.clock.request_arrival_ns(req.rid),
+                "first_token_ns": first_ns,
+                "last_token_ns": last_ns,
+                "commit_ns": self.commit_ns,
+                "terminal_ns": self.commit_ns if req.finished() else None,
+                "prompt_tokens": len(req.origin_input_ids),
+                "completion_tokens": count,
+                "cached_tokens": req.cached_tokens,
+            }
+            # Replace instead of mutating: an earlier IPC output may still hold it.
+            setattr(req, _REQUEST_ATTRIBUTE, snapshot)
+        if self.token_events is not None and output_events:
+            self.token_events.record(self.commit_ns, output_events)
+
+
+def attach_timing_output(
+    result, clock: Coordinator, token_events: TokenEventRecorder | None = None
+) -> None:
+    result.auxiliary_host_output = TimingMetadataOutput(
+        clock, clock.now_ns, result.auxiliary_host_output, token_events
+    )
+
+
+class C_TimingOutputStreamerHook(BaseHook):
+    HOOK_CLASS_NAME = "SchedulerOutputStreamer"
+    HOOK_MODULE_NAME = "sglang.srt.managers.scheduler_components.output_streamer"
+
+    @classmethod
+    def hook(cls, target):
+        original = target.build_additional_customized_info
+
+        @wraps(original)
+        def build(self, reqs):
+            info = original(self, reqs)
+            if METADATA_KEY in info:
+                raise ProtocolError(f"reserved response metadata key: {METADATA_KEY}")
+            info[METADATA_KEY] = [
+                getattr(req, _REQUEST_ATTRIBUTE, None) for req in reqs
+            ]
+            return info
+
+        target.has_additional_customized_info = True
+        target.build_additional_customized_info = build
+
+
+class C_TimingTokenizerHook(BaseHook):
+    HOOK_CLASS_NAME = "TokenizerManager"
+    HOOK_MODULE_NAME = "sglang.srt.managers.tokenizer_manager"
+    # Tokenizer and OpenAI serving classes are absent from scheduler workers.
+    REQUIRED = False
+
+    @classmethod
+    def hook(cls, target):
+        original = target.update_request_meta_info
+
+        @wraps(original)
+        def update(self, meta_info, state, customized_info, index, finish_reason):
+            original(
+                self,
+                meta_info,
+                state,
+                {
+                    key: value
+                    for key, value in customized_info.items()
+                    if key != METADATA_KEY
+                },
+                index,
+                finish_reason,
+            )
+            snapshots = customized_info.get(METADATA_KEY)
+            if snapshots is not None and snapshots[index] is not None:
+                # Native token metadata is accumulated and sliced. A snapshot is
+                # request-level data and must survive coalescing as a whole.
+                meta_info[METADATA_KEY] = snapshots[index]
+
+        target.update_request_meta_info = update
+
+
+class C_TimingChatHook(BaseHook):
+    HOOK_CLASS_NAME = "OpenAIServingChat"
+    HOOK_MODULE_NAME = "sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_chat"
+    REQUIRED = False
+
+    @classmethod
+    def hook(cls, target):
+        original = target._generate_stream_content
+
+        @wraps(original)
+        async def generate(self, content, *args, **kwargs):
+            snapshot = content["meta_info"].get(METADATA_KEY)
+            finish_reason = content["meta_info"].get("finish_reason") or {}
+            if snapshot is None and finish_reason.get("type") != "abort":
+                raise ProtocolError("coordinated chat response lacks timing metadata")
+            if snapshot is not None:
+                yield (
+                    f"event: {METADATA_KEY}\n"
+                    f"data: {msgspec.json.encode(snapshot).decode()}\n\n"
+                )
+            async for chunk in original(self, content, *args, **kwargs):
+                yield chunk
+
+        target._generate_stream_content = generate

+"""Stream exact native output-token commits without retaining token payloads."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+from os import PathLike
+
+
+class TokenEventRecorder:
+    """Write an opt-in JSONL ledger, finalized only after simulator success.
+
+    ``output_index`` is the zero-based position of the first token in a commit;
+    ``token_count`` is its positive increment, not a cumulative output length.
+    One counter per request enforces continuity even for requests later cancelled.
+    The caller owns lifecycle/phase selection; this ledger records all commits.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str | PathLike[str]) -> None:
+        # The simulator owns this stream across batches and closes it on exit.
+        self._stream = open(path, "x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")  # noqa: SIM115
+        self._last_ns = 0
+        self._counts: dict[str, int] = {}
+        self._total_output_tokens = 0
+        self._finished: tuple[str, int] | None = None
+        self._write_event({"event": "start", "version": 1, "clock": "virtual_ns"})
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _nonnegative_integer(value: int, name: str) -> None:
+        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a nonnegative integer")
+
+    def _check_open(self) -> None:
+        if self._stream.closed:
+            raise RuntimeError("token event recorder is finished or closed")
+
+    def _check_time(self, at_ns: int) -> None:
+        self._nonnegative_integer(at_ns, "at_ns")
+        if at_ns < self._last_ns:
+            raise ValueError("token event time must be monotonic")
+
+    def _write_event(self, event: dict) -> None:
+        # Serialize before touching the file; an I/O failure cannot be followed
+        # by a success footer, even if the caller catches the original error.
+        line = json.dumps(event, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
+        try:
+            self._stream.write(line)
+            self._stream.flush()
+        except BaseException:
+            self.close()
+            raise
+
+    def record(self, at_ns: int, commits: Iterable[tuple[str, int, int]]) -> None:
+        """Record one batch of ``(rid, output_index, token_count)`` triples.
+
+        Validate the entire iterable before writing or updating counters. Empty
+        batches advance the checked clock but do not produce output events.
+        """
+        self._check_open()
+        self._check_time(at_ns)
+        pending: dict[str, int] = {}
+        entries = []
+        added = 0
+        for rid, output_index, token_count in commits:
+            if not isinstance(rid, str) or not rid:
+                raise ValueError("rid must be a nonempty string")
+            self._nonnegative_integer(output_index, "output_index")
+            self._nonnegative_integer(token_count, "token_count")
+            if token_count == 0:
+                raise ValueError("token_count must be positive")
+            expected = pending.get(rid, self._counts.get(rid, 0))
+            if output_index != expected:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"non-contiguous token commit for {rid}: "
+                    f"expected output_index {expected}, got {output_index}"
+                )
+            pending[rid] = expected + token_count
+            added += token_count
+            entries.append(
+                {"rid": rid, "output_index": output_index, "token_count": token_count}
+            )
+        if entries:
+            self._write_event(
+                {"event": "output_commit", "at_ns": at_ns, "commits": entries}
+            )
+        self._counts.update(pending)
+        self._total_output_tokens += added
+        self._last_ns = at_ns
+
+    def finish(self, run_id: str, at_ns: int) -> None:
+        """Write the success footer and close; an identical repeat is harmless."""
+        if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not run_id:
+            raise ValueError("run_id must be a nonempty string")
+        self._check_time(at_ns)
+        if self._finished == (run_id, at_ns):
+            return
+        self._check_open()
+        self._write_event(
+            {
+                "event": "finish",
+                "run_id": run_id,
+                "at_ns": at_ns,
+                "status": "FINISHED",
+                "total_output_tokens": self._total_output_tokens,
+            }
+        )
+        self._last_ns = at_ns
+        self._finished = (run_id, at_ns)
+        self.close()
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        """Close an interrupted or completed ledger without adding any events."""
+        self._stream.close()

+"""Source-defined golden3.51 progress, separate from measured worker costs.
+
+SHA256/mod100 is an explicit simulator sampling algorithm. It models the pinned
+match-expected law; it does not replay native Torch CPU generator consumption.
+The SDK owns original-source/material verification and the marginal cost contract.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+
+from sglang_simulator.simulation.sglang.dspark import DSparkProgress
+from sglang_simulator.time_predictor.base import PredictorError
+
+LAW = "dspark_match_expected_351_v1"
+ALGORITHM = "sha256_decode_event_mod100_v1"
+
+
+def _require(condition, message):
+    if not condition:
+        raise PredictorError("data_unavailable", message)
+
+
+def _canonical(value):
+    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)
+
+
+class SourceGoldenDSparkProgress:
+    """One modeled choice per DECODE event, with idempotent before-work retries.
+
+    This law represents TP2/TP4 B1-B64, with ADP1/PP1. SDK policy verifies static
+    Q5/Q6, captures and the golden cost realization. Session resolves every
+    measured phase before calling this owner. Missing costs never draw progress.
+    """
+

+"""Validate the SDK-to-simulator native phase binding without projecting work.
+
+The SDK owns causal projection, source qualification and UMD preparation. These
+checks only bind its one-region graph to the existing simulator phase and step.
+They neither construct source attestations nor enable an incomplete factory.
+"""
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+
+from sglang_simulator.time_predictor.base import PredictorError
+
+_REGIONS = {
+    "EXTEND": {
+        "worker_preamble": "prefill_preamble",
+        "target_prefill": "prefill_target",
+        "draft_kv_inject": "prefill_draft_kv",
+        "worker_tail": "prefill_tail",
+    },
+    "TARGET_VERIFY": {
+        "worker_preamble": "decode_preamble",
+        "proposal": "decode_proposal",
+        "target_verify": "decode_target",
+        "accept_commit_publication": "decode_accept_commit",
+        "worker_tail": "decode_tail",
+    },
+}
+
+
+def _canonical(value):
+    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)
+
+
+def validate_native_region_phase(*, description, point, graph_phase, phase, step):
+    """Return whether this is a native region; reject an incomplete binding.
+
+    Runtime/source attestations must originate in the SDK's prospective
+    preparer. Current SDK region preparation alone does not issue them. The
+    existing canonical module_variant is transported unchanged, not rebuilt
+    from a simulator mirror or a current-forward outcome.
+    """
+    graph = description.op_graph
+    nodes = getattr(graph, graph_phase)
+    if description.extra.get(
+        "module_operation"
+    ) != "dsv41_native_segment_module" and not any(
+        node.op == "dsv41_native_segment_module" for node in nodes
+    ):
+        return False
+
+    from infercast.sdk.native_segment_module import OP, NativeSegmentQuery
+
+    def require(condition):
+        if not condition:
+            raise ValueError("native region does not bind the complete causal phase")
+
+    try:
+        require(
+            (
+                step.topology.tp_size,
+                step.topology.attention_dp_size,
+                step.topology.pp_size,
+            )
+            in {(2, 1, 1), (4, 1, 1)}
+            and len(step.groups) == 1
+            and 1 <= len(step.requests) <= 64
+        )
+        group = step.groups[0]
+        region = _REGIONS[group.forward_mode][phase]
+        expected_phase = "context" if group.forward_mode == "EXTEND" else "generation"
+        require(graph_phase == expected_phase)
+        require(
+            len(nodes) == 1
+            and not getattr(
+                graph, "generation" if graph_phase == "context" else "context"
+            )
+        )
+        node = nodes[0]
+        require(
+            node.id == region
+            and node.op == OP
+            and type(node.count) is int
+            and node.count == 1
+            and node.cond is None
+            and node.layer_group == "all"
+            and graph.layer_repeat == {"all": 1}
+            and type(graph.layer_repeat["all"]) is int
+            and getattr(graph, graph_phase + "_composition")
+            == ["sum", ["node", region]]
+        )
+        shapes = json.loads(point["native_segment_queries"])
+        require(isinstance(shapes, list) and len(shapes) == 1)
+        query = NativeSegmentQuery.from_shape(shapes[0])
+        native = query.native_input
+        require(
+            query.segment_kind == region
+            and native.to_dict()["tp_size"] == step.topology.tp_size
+            and _canonical(node.shape)
+            == _canonical(
+                {key: ["lit", value] for key, value in query.to_shape().items()}
+            )
+            and description.extra.get("module_operation") == OP
+            and description.extra.get("native_worker_phase") == native.forward_mode
+            and description.extra.get("complete_dspark_worker_phase") == phase
+            and description.extra.get("native_segment_profile_id")
+            == query.execution_profile_id
+            and description.extra.get("native_segment_runtime_profile_sha256")
+            == hashlib.sha256(step.runtime_profile_json.encode()).hexdigest()
+        )
+        execution = json.loads(group.execution_json)
+        require(
+            execution["native_segment_profile_id"] == query.execution_profile_id
+            and execution["native_segment_module_variant"] == query.module_variant
+            and tuple((r.prefix_len, r.extend_len) for r in native.requests)
+            == tuple((r.target_prefix_len, r.extend_len) for r in group.requests)
+            and _canonical(native.to_dict()["sampling_recipe"]["per_attention_dp"])
+            == _canonical(
+                [[json.loads(r.sampling_params_json) for r in group.requests]]
+            )
+        )
+        if group.forward_mode == "TARGET_VERIFY":
+            variant = json.loads(query.module_variant)
+            require(
+                (
+                    variant["schema_version"] in (2, 3)
+                    or variant["draft_history_tokens"]
+                    == [r.bounded_draft_history_tokens(128) for r in group.requests]
+                )
+                and type(execution["draft_buffer_capacity"]) is int
+                and variant["buffer_capacity"] == execution["draft_buffer_capacity"]
+                and variant["buffer_device_matches"]
+                is execution["draft_buffer_device_matches"]
+            )
+    except (KeyError, IndexError, ValueError, TypeError) as error:
+        raise PredictorError(
+            "data_unavailable", "SDK native region phase/source binding is unavailable"
+        ) from error
+    return True

+"""Independent empirical DSPark progress from retained training/heldout rows.
+
+This loader fits conditional commit-count distributions from training rows only.
+It reports heldout distribution/mean errors without inventing an acceptance
+threshold. A successfully loaded artifact is not an accuracy admission.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import bisect
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+from collections import Counter, defaultdict
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sglang_simulator.simulation.sglang.dspark import DSparkProgress
+from sglang_simulator.time_predictor.base import PredictorError
+
+DEFINITION = "dspark_recipe_prefix_history_empirical_commit_v1"
+
+
+def _error(message, **details):
+    raise PredictorError("invalid_progress_artifact", message, **details)
+
+
+def _canonical(value):
+    return json.dumps(
+        value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False
+    ).encode()
+
+
+def _digest(value):
+    return type(value) is str and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", value) is not None
+
+
+def _strict_json(raw):
+    def unique(pairs):
+        result = {}
+        for k, v in pairs:
+            if k in result:
+                _error("duplicate progress JSON field")
+            result[k] = v
+        return result
+
+    try:
+        value = json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=unique)
+        _canonical(value)
+        return value
+    except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
+        raise PredictorError(
+            "invalid_progress_artifact", "progress JSON must be finite and valid"
+        ) from error
+
+
+class EmpiricalDSparkProgress:
+    """Sample modeled commits from before-work, never from a live accept result.
+
+    A row's trajectory identifies an independent request/conversation campaign;
+    training and heldout trajectories cannot overlap. Its retained native key and
+    full recipe are provenance. Prefix/history binning is an explicit model
+    hypothesis whose heldout errors remain visible.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, path, *, expected_sha256, runtime_profile_json):
+        from infercast.sdk.native_sources import NATIVE_SOURCE_0522
+        from infercast.sdk.native_windows import MAX_NATIVE_WINDOW_BYTES
+
+        path = Path(path)
+        if (
+            path.is_symlink()
+            or not path.is_file()
+            or path.stat().st_size > 64 * 1024**2
+        ):
+            _error("progress artifact must be a regular file")
+        path = path.resolve(strict=True)
+        raw = path.read_bytes()
+        if (
+            not _digest(expected_sha256)
+            or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != expected_sha256
+        ):
+            _error("progress artifact digest differs")
+        data = _strict_json(raw)
+        fields = {
+            "schema_version",
+            "definition",
+            "runtime_profile_sha256",
+            "source_pin",
+            "seed",
+            "prefix_edges",
+            "history_edges",
+            "training",
+            "validation",
+        }
+        if (
+            not isinstance(data, dict)
+            or set(data) != fields
+            or type(data["schema_version"]) is not int
+            or data["schema_version"] != 1
+            or data["definition"] != DEFINITION
+        ):
+            _error("progress artifact fields or definition differ")
+        if (
+            data["runtime_profile_sha256"]
+            != hashlib.sha256(runtime_profile_json.encode()).hexdigest()
+            or data["source_pin"] != NATIVE_SOURCE_0522.name
+        ):
+            _error("progress model must match the exact runtime/source cohort")
+        if type(data["seed"]) is not int or data["seed"] < 0:
+            _error("progress seed must be explicit and nonnegative")
+        for name in ("prefix_edges", "history_edges"):
+            edges = data[name]
+            if (
+                not isinstance(edges, list)
+                or any(type(v) is not int or v < 1 for v in edges)
+                or edges != sorted(set(edges))
+            ):
+                _error("progress bin edges must be sorted distinct positive integers")
+        self.model_ref = "sha256:" + expected_sha256
+        self.profile_digest = data["runtime_profile_sha256"]
+        self.source_pin = data["source_pin"]
+        self.seed = data["seed"]
+        self.prefix_edges = tuple(data["prefix_edges"])
+        self.history_edges = tuple(data["history_edges"])
+        self.distributions = defaultdict(Counter)
+        trajectories = {"training": set(), "validation": set()}
+        seen = set()
+        rows = {}
+        request_splits = {}
+        native_cache = {}
+
+        def read_evidence(ref):
+            if (
+                not isinstance(ref, dict)
+                or set(ref) != {"path", "sha256"}
+                or not _digest(ref["sha256"])
+            ):
+                _error("invalid native progress evidence descriptor")
+            relative = ref["path"]
+            if (
+                type(relative) is not str
+                or re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+\.json", relative) is None
+            ):
+                _error("native progress evidence must be a retained sibling JSON")
+            key = relative, ref["sha256"]
+            if key not in native_cache:
+                p = path.parent / relative
+                if (
+                    p.is_symlink()
+                    or not p.is_file()
+                    or p.stat().st_size > MAX_NATIVE_WINDOW_BYTES
+                ):
+                    _error("native progress evidence must be bounded regular bytes")
+                with p.open("rb") as stream:
+                    content = stream.read(MAX_NATIVE_WINDOW_BYTES + 1)
+                if len(content) > MAX_NATIVE_WINDOW_BYTES:
+                    _error("native progress evidence must be bounded regular bytes")
+                if hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() != ref["sha256"]:
+                    _error("native progress evidence digest differs")
+                native_cache[key] = _strict_json(content)
+            return native_cache[key]
+
+        def read_rows(split):
+            descriptors = data[split]
+            if not isinstance(descriptors, list) or not descriptors:
+                _error(
+                    "progress needs independent nonempty training and validation originals"
+                )
+            result = []
+            for ref in descriptors:
+                if (
+                    not isinstance(ref, dict)
+                    or set(ref) != {"path", "sha256"}
+                    or not _digest(ref["sha256"])
+                ):
+                    _error("progress original descriptor differs")
+                relative = ref["path"]
+                if (
+                    type(relative) is not str
+                    or re.fullmatch(
+                        r"progress-observations-" + ref["sha256"] + r"\.json", relative
+                    )
+                    is None
+                ):
+                    _error("progress observations must be retained beside the artifact")
+                original = path.parent / relative
+                if (
+                    original.is_symlink()
+                    or not original.is_file()
+                    or original.stat().st_size > 64 * 1024**2
+                ):
+                    _error("progress observations must be bounded regular originals")
+                raw_rows = original.read_bytes()
+                if hashlib.sha256(raw_rows).hexdigest() != ref["sha256"]:
+                    _error("progress observation bytes differ")
+                document = _strict_json(raw_rows)
+                if (
+                    not isinstance(document, dict)
+                    or set(document)
+                    != {
+                        "schema_version",
+                        "source_pin",
+                        "runtime_profile_sha256",
+                        "observations",
+                        "native",
+                        "participants",
+                        "phase_policy",
+                        "causal_history_evidence",
+                    }
+                    or type(document["schema_version"]) is not int
+                    or document["schema_version"] != 1
+                    or document["source_pin"] != self.source_pin
+                    or document["runtime_profile_sha256"] != self.profile_digest
+                    or not isinstance(document["observations"], list)
+                ):
+                    _error(
+                        "progress observations differ from their runtime/source cohort"
+                    )
+                if (
+                    not isinstance(document["causal_history_evidence"], list)
+                    or not document["causal_history_evidence"]
+                ):
+                    _error("progress history projection needs retained causal evidence")
+                for ref in document["causal_history_evidence"]:
+                    read_evidence(ref)
+                identities, batch_sizes = _verify_native_progress_context(
+                    document, read_evidence
+                )
+                topology = tuple(
+                    document["participants"][0][k]
+                    for k in ("tp_size", "attn_dp_size", "pp_size")
+                )
+                if hasattr(self, "topology") and self.topology != topology:
+                    _error("progress originals mix different execution topologies")
+                self.topology = topology
+                for row in document["observations"]:
+                    self._validate_row(row)
+                    previous_split = request_splits.setdefault(row["rid"], split)
+                    if previous_split != split:
+                        _error(
+                            "native request lineage overlaps training and validation"
+                        )
+                    key = identities[row["native_key"]]
+                    if key in seen:
+                        _error(
+                            "duplicate native progress observation or train/heldout leakage"
+                        )
+                    seen.add(key)
+                    trajectories[split].add(row["trajectory_id"])
+                    result.append((row, batch_sizes[row["native_key"]]))

+        for split in ("training", "validation"):
+            rows[split] = read_rows(split)

+            self.distributions[self._row_key(row)][row["commit_len"]] += 1

+        for row, _ in rows["validation"]:

+        self.validated_keys = set(heldout) & set(self.distributions)
+        for key in sorted(set(heldout) | set(self.distributions)):
+            train = self.distributions.get(key, Counter())
+            val = heldout.get(key, Counter())
+            nt, nv = sum(train.values()), sum(val.values())
+            train_mean = sum(k * n for k, n in train.items()) / nt if nt else None
+            val_mean = sum(k * n for k, n in val.items()) / nv if nv else None
+            self.validation.append(
+                {
+                    "cell": key,
+                    "training_count": nt,
+                    "validation_count": nv,
+                    "training_batch_sizes": sorted(
+                        size for cell, size in batch_support["training"] if cell == key
+                    ),
+                    "validation_batch_sizes": sorted(
+                        size
+                        for cell, size in batch_support["validation"]
+                        if cell == key
+                    ),
+                    "supported_batch_sizes": sorted(
+                        size for cell, size in self.validated_batch_keys if cell == key
+                    ),
+                    "training_mean": train_mean,
+                    "validation_mean": val_mean,
+                    "mean_error": train_mean - val_mean if nt and nv else None,
+                    "total_variation": sum(
+                        abs(train[k] / nt - val[k] / nv) for k in range(1, 7)
+                    )
+                    / 2
+                    if nt and nv
+                    else None,
+                }
+            )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_row(row):
+        from infercast.sdk.native_sampling import SAMPLING_FIELDS
+
+        fields = {
+            "native_key",
+            "forward_ct",
+            "rid",
+            "trajectory_id",
+            "prefix_len",
+            "draft_history_tokens",
+            "sampling_params",
+            "verify_width",
+            "commit_len",
+        }
+        if (
+            not isinstance(row, dict)
+            or set(row) != fields
+            or type(row["forward_ct"]) is not int
+            or row["forward_ct"] < 0
+            or any(
+                type(row[name]) is not str or not row[name]
+                for name in ("native_key", "trajectory_id", "rid")

+def _source_work_query_evidence(recorder, *, point, phase, policy, source_policy):
+    """Bind one estimated SDK lookup to its original request and row anchors."""
+    from infercast.sdk.diagnostics.prediction_evidence import linear_axis
+    from infercast.sdk.native_segment_module import OP, NativeSegmentQuery
+
+    def canonical(value):
+        return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)
+
+    def require(condition):
+        if not condition:
+            raise ValueError("missing matching SDK source-work query proof")
+
+    try:
+        shapes = json.loads(point["native_segment_queries"])
+        require(
+            len(shapes) == 1
+            and recorder.dropped_queries == 0
+            and len(recorder.nodes) == 1
+        )
+        requested = NativeSegmentQuery.from_shape(shapes[0])
+        coordinate, prefix = requested.source_work_coordinate(policy=policy)
+        node = recorder.nodes[0]
+        require(
+            node["op"] == OP
+            and node["node_id"] == requested.segment_kind
+            and node["phase"] == phase
+            and node["status"] == "resolved"
+            and node["source"] == "empirical"
+            and type(node["count"]) is int
+            and node["count"] == 1
+            and type(node["repeat"]) is int
+            and node["repeat"] == 1
+            and canonical(node["shape"]) == canonical(requested.to_shape())
+            and len(node["queries"]) == 1
+        )
+        query = node["queries"][0]
+        metadata = query["row_metadata"]
+        require(
+            query["component"] == OP
+            and query["role"] == "leaf"
+            and query["source"] == "empirical"
+            and query["kernel_source"] == "sglang"
+            and query["kernel_impl"] == requested.to_shape()["kernel_impl"]
+            and query["resolution"] in {"fallback", "interpolated"}
+            and canonical(query["requested_key"]) == canonical(requested.to_shape())
+            and requested.execution_profile_id == source_policy.execution_profile_id
+            and metadata["execution_profile_id"] == requested.execution_profile_id
+            and metadata["estimated_source_work_policy"]
+            == metadata["interpolation_method"]
+            == policy
+            and metadata["source_binding_scope"] == "conditional_helper_file_inventory"
+            and metadata["source_work_coordinate_sha256"]
+            == hashlib.sha256(coordinate.encode()).hexdigest()
+        )
+        anchors = metadata["anchor_identities"]
+        require(len(anchors) == 2)
+        endpoints = []
+        for shape in anchors:
+            anchor = NativeSegmentQuery.from_shape(shape)
+            group, position = anchor.source_work_coordinate(policy=policy)
+            require(group == coordinate)
+            endpoints.append(position)

+        require(lower <= prefix <= upper)
+        require(lower != upper or canonical(anchors[0]) == canonical(anchors[1]))

+            canonical(query["axes"])
+            == canonical([linear_axis("prefix_len", prefix, lower, upper, weight)])
+        )
+        require(
+            query["resolution"] == ("fallback" if lower == upper else "interpolated")
+        )
+        return query
+    except (AttributeError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
+        raise PredictorError(
+            "data_unavailable",
+            "DSPark estimated cost lacks matching SDK source-work evidence",
+        ) from error

+            if cost_evidence_path is not None:
+                if (
+                    type(cost_evidence_path) is not str
+                    or not cost_evidence_path.strip()
+                ):
+                    raise PredictorError(
+                        "invalid_execution_profile",
+                        "cost evidence path must be explicit",
+                    )
+                path = Path(cost_evidence_path).absolute()
+                try:
+                    # The caller selects a fresh run output; never append to or
+                    # replace another run's ledger.
+                    self._cost_sink = path.open("xb", buffering=0)
+                    self._cost_sink_path = path
+                except OSError as error:
+                    raise PredictorError(
+                        "data_unavailable", "cannot create native cost evidence ledger"
+                    ) from error
+        elif cost_evidence_path is not None:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "invalid_execution_profile", "cost evidence requires an analytic model"
+            )
+
+    def get_cost_metrics(self):
+        """Report evaluated query costs, including the complete theory fraction."""
+        if hasattr(self, "_native_joint"):
+            return self._joint_cost_metrics()
+        if self._cost_sink_failed:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable", "native cost evidence write failed"
+            )
+        if self.native_analytic_model is None:
+            return None
+        by_source = {}
+        for row in self._cost_counts.values():
+            target = by_source.setdefault(row["source"], {"queries": 0, "seconds": 0.0})
+            target["queries"] += row["queries"]
+            target["seconds"] += row["seconds"]
+        total = math.fsum(row["seconds"] for row in by_source.values())
+        theory = by_source.get("sol", {}).get("seconds", 0.0)
+        return {
+            "scope": "evaluated_cost_queries_not_committed_forward_events",
+            "model": self.native_analytic_model.to_dict(),
+            "by_source": by_source,
+            "by_phase_source": [dict(row) for row in self._cost_counts.values()],
+            "theoretical_seconds": theory,
+            "total_evaluated_seconds": total,
+            "theoretical_fraction": theory / total if total else 0.0,
+            "ledger": None
+            if self._cost_sink is None
+            else {
+                "path": str(self._cost_sink_path),
+                "bytes": self._cost_sink_bytes,
+                "sha256": self._cost_sink_digest.hexdigest(),
+                "encoding": "canonical_utf8_jsonl",
+                "write_failed": self._cost_sink_failed,
+            },
+        }
+
+    def _write_cost_line(self, line):
+        if self._cost_sink_failed:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable", "native cost evidence write failed"
+            )
+        if self._cost_sink is None:
+            return
+        try:
+            if self._cost_sink.write(line) != len(line):
+                raise OSError("incomplete native cost evidence write")
+            self._cost_sink.flush()
+        except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
+            self._cost_sink_failed = True
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable", "native cost evidence write failed"
+            ) from error
+        self._cost_sink_digest.update(line)
+        self._cost_sink_bytes += len(line)
+
+    def execution_for(
+        self,
+        *,
+        group,
+        runtime_profile_json,
+        native_batch=None,
+        buffer_capacity=None,
+        buffer_device_matches=None,
+        reference_view=None,
+    ):
+        """Resolve SDK work from explicit before-work inputs.
+
+        A native policy requires the source driver's frozen reference CPU view
+        and matching request metadata. The legacy proposal path resolves only
+        its own capture and does not reinterpret reference planning inputs.
+        """
+        if hasattr(self, "_native_joint"):
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable",
+                "joint costs require the complete peer execution resolver",
+            )
+        if self.native_source_policy is not None:
+            return self._native_execution(
+                group=group,
+                runtime_profile_json=runtime_profile_json,
+                native_batch=native_batch,
+                buffer_capacity=buffer_capacity,
+                buffer_device_matches=buffer_device_matches,
+                reference_view=reference_view,
+            )
+        if reference_view is not None:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable",
+                "reference CPU inputs require the complete native SDK source policy",
+            )
+        from infercast.sdk.perf_database.slice_manifest import (
+            read_verified_slice_artifact,
+        )
+
+        if group.forward_mode != "TARGET_VERIFY":
+            return {"forward_mode": group.forward_mode}
+        if self.proposal_profile_id is None:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable", "DSPark draft execution profile is absent"
+            )
+        if self._proposal_profile is None:
+            root = self.database.slice_ref.slice_dir
+            identities = json.loads(
+                read_verified_slice_artifact(root, "_meta/kernel_identity.json")
+            )["identities"]
+            refs = [
+                entry.get("extra", {}).get("execution_profile")
+                for entry in identities
+                if entry.get("op") == "dsv41_dspark_proposal_module"
+                and entry.get("config_token") == self.proposal_profile_id
+            ]
+            if not refs or any(ref != refs[0] for ref in refs):
+                raise PredictorError(
+                    "data_unavailable", "DSPark draft profile is missing or ambiguous"
+                )
+            ref = refs[0]
+            if ref is None or ref.get("sha256") != self.proposal_profile_id:
+                raise PredictorError(
+                    "invalid_execution_profile", "DSPark draft profile identity differs"
+                )
+            self._proposal_profile = json.loads(
+                read_verified_slice_artifact(
+                    root, ref["path"], expected_sha256=ref["sha256"]
+                )
+            )
+        definition = self._proposal_profile["graph_definition"]
+        key = {
+            "size": len(group.requests),
+            "attention_variant": None,
+            "stream_idx": None,
+            "variant_label": None,
+        }
+        eligible = (
+            definition.get("tokens_per_request") == 5
+            and definition.get("ragged_verify_mode") is False
+            and key in definition.get("capture_keys", [])
+        )
+        if not eligible:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable",
+                "DSPark draft capture has no matching source profile",
+            )
+        return {"draft_capture_key": key, "draft_graph_eligible": True}
+
+    def _native_execution(
+        self,
+        *,
+        group,
+        runtime_profile_json,
+        native_batch,
+        buffer_capacity,
+        buffer_device_matches,
+        reference_view,
+    ):
+        from sglang_simulator.simulation.sglang.dspark_reference import ReferenceCPUView
+        from sglang_simulator.simulation.sglang.dspark_runtime import (
+            capture_simulator_source_facts,
+            sampling_snapshot,
+        )
+        from sglang_simulator.time_predictor.dspark_native_regions import _REGIONS
+
+        if type(reference_view) is not ReferenceCPUView:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable",
+                "native projection requires the source driver's before-work reference CPU view",
+                missing_source_facts=["reference_view"],
+            )
+        if native_batch is None:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable",
+                "native projection requires the matching before-work request metadata",
+                missing_source_facts=["native_batch"],
+            )
+        facts = capture_simulator_source_facts(native_batch)
+        decode = group.forward_mode == "TARGET_VERIFY"
+        mode = "DECODE" if decode else "EXTEND"
+        if (
+            group.attention_dp_rank != 0
+            or group.forward_mode not in _REGIONS
+            or facts.forward_mode != mode
+            or tuple((r.rid, r.max_new_tokens) for r in facts.requests)
+            != tuple((r.rid, r.max_new_tokens) for r in group.requests)
+            or tuple(sampling_snapshot(r.sampling_params) for r in native_batch.reqs)
+            != tuple(r.sampling_params_json for r in group.requests)
+        ):
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable",
+                "native projection request order, mode or complete sampling differs from the reference step",
+            )
+        from infercast.sdk.extend_forward import ExtendRequestShape
+        from infercast.sdk.native_segment_projection import project_native_segment_query
+
+        try:
+            query = project_native_segment_query(
+                execution_profile_id=self.native_source_policy.execution_profile_id,
+                segment_kind=next(iter(_REGIONS[group.forward_mode].values())),
+                source_policy=self.native_source_policy,
+                runtime_profile_json=runtime_profile_json,
+                forward_mode=mode,
+                request_work=tuple(
+                    ExtendRequestShape(
+                        prefix_len=r.target_prefix_len, extend_len=r.extend_len
+                    )
+                    for r in group.requests
+                ),
+                normalized_sampling=tuple(
+                    json.loads(r.sampling_params_json) for r in group.requests
+                ),
+                request_metadata=tuple(
+                    (
+                        r.origin_input_len,
+                        r.to_finish_present,
+                        r.input_embeds_present,
+                        r.multimodal_inputs_present,
+                    )
+                    for r in facts.requests
+                ),
+                seq_lens_cpu=reference_view.seq_lens_cpu,
+                nxt_kv_lens_cpu=reference_view.nxt_kv_lens_cpu,
+                buffer_capacity=buffer_capacity if decode else None,
+                buffer_device_matches=buffer_device_matches if decode else None,
+            )
+        except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError) as error:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable",
+                "native SDK projection lacks compatible causal inputs",
+                reason=str(error),
+            ) from error
+        return {
+            "native_segment_profile_id": query.execution_profile_id,
+            "native_segment_module_variant": query.module_variant,
+        }
+
+    def _prepare_native(self, *, step, phase):
+        from sglang_simulator.time_predictor.dspark_native_regions import _REGIONS
+
+        try:
+            from infercast.sdk.models.umd.templates.deepseek_v41_segments import (
+                prepare_native_dspark_phase,
+            )
+            from infercast.sdk.native_segment_module import NativeSegmentQuery
+
+            if (
+                step.topology.tp_size,
+                step.topology.attention_dp_size,
+                step.topology.pp_size,
+            ) not in {(2, 1, 1), (4, 1, 1)} or len(step.groups) != 1:
+                raise ValueError("native region profile requires TP2/TP4 ADP1/PP1")
+            group = step.groups[0]
+            execution = json.loads(group.execution_json)
+            if (
+                execution["native_segment_profile_id"]
+                != self.native_source_policy.execution_profile_id
+                or step.runtime_profile_json
+                != self.native_source_policy.runtime_profile_json
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "native region policy/runtime changed after projection"
+                )
+            query = NativeSegmentQuery(
+                execution["native_segment_profile_id"],
+                _REGIONS[group.forward_mode][phase],
+                execution["native_segment_module_variant"],
+            )
+            if not (
+                self.native_source_policy.tp_size
+                == step.topology.tp_size
+                == query.native_input.to_dict()["tp_size"]
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "native region policy/query topology changed after projection"
+                )
+            return prepare_native_dspark_phase(
+                query=query, phase=phase, runtime_profile_json=step.runtime_profile_json
+            )
+        except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError) as error:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable", "native SDK phase projection is unavailable"
+            ) from error
+
+    def _prepare_proposal(self, *, step, phase):
+        from infercast.sdk.dspark_proposal import project_dspark_proposal_work
+        from infercast.sdk.extend_forward import ExtendRequestShape
+        from infercast.sdk.models.umd.templates.deepseek_v41_proposal import (
+            prepare_dspark_proposal_module,
+        )
+
+        if (step.topology.tp_size, step.topology.attention_dp_size) != (2, 1):
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable",
+                "proposal PerfDB has no matching TP4/ADP2 realization",
+            )
+        group = step.groups[0]
+        execution = json.loads(group.execution_json)
+        try:
+            before = {
+                "request_work": tuple(
+                    ExtendRequestShape(prefix_len=r.target_prefix_len, extend_len=5)
+                    for r in group.requests
+                ),
+                "draft_history_tokens": tuple(
+                    r.bounded_draft_history_tokens(128) for r in group.requests
+                ),
+                "sampling_params": tuple(
+                    json.loads(r.sampling_params_json) for r in group.requests
+                ),
+                "buffer_capacity": execution["draft_buffer_capacity"],
+                "buffer_device_matches": execution["draft_buffer_device_matches"],
+                "graph_eligible": execution["draft_graph_eligible"],
+            }
+            query = project_dspark_proposal_work(
+                execution_profile_id=self.proposal_profile_id,
+                capture_key=json.dumps(
+                    execution["draft_capture_key"],
+                    sort_keys=True,
+                    separators=(",", ":"),
+                ),
+                **before,
+            )
+        except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError) as error:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable",
+                "proposal is outside the source-bound causal cost class",
+            ) from error
+        description, point = prepare_dspark_proposal_module(query, **before)
+        return description, point, "generation"
+
+    def query_phase(self, phase, step):
+        from infercast.sdk.models.umd.description import bind_runtime_point
+        from infercast.sdk.models.umd.executor import evaluate_phase_composition
+        from infercast.sdk.perf_database.database import PerfDataNotAvailableError
+
+        if phase not in self.preparers:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable", f"missing complete DSPark worker phase: {phase}"
+            )
+        description, point, graph_phase = self.preparers[phase](phase=phase, step=step)
+        graph = description.op_graph
+        if graph is None or graph_phase not in {"context", "generation"}:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "invalid_execution_profile", "DSPark cost needs its UMD prepared graph"
+            )
+        from sglang_simulator.time_predictor.dspark_native_regions import (
+            validate_native_region_phase,
+        )
+
+        native_region = validate_native_region_phase(
+            description=description,
+            point=point,
+            graph_phase=graph_phase,
+            phase=phase,
+            step=step,
+        )
+        if (phase != "proposal" or native_region) and description.extra.get(
+            "complete_dspark_worker_phase"
+        ) != phase:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable",
+                "UMD graph does not cover the complete requested DSPark phase",
+            )
+        if phase == "target_verify" and description.extra.get(
+            "unmodeled_target_call_units"
+        ):
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable",
+                "target module composition leaves target-call work uncovered",
+            )
+        nodes = getattr(graph, graph_phase)
+        if not nodes or any(node.op == "const_latency" for node in nodes):
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable", "DSPark costs require measured UMD operations"
+            )
+        source_work = (
+            self.native_source_work_policy is not None
+            and native_region
+            and len(step.groups) == 1
+            and step.groups[0].forward_mode == "TARGET_VERIFY"
+            and len(step.groups[0].requests) == 1
+        )
+        evaluation = {
+            "phase": graph_phase,
+            "env": bind_runtime_point(description, point),
+            "layer_repeat": graph.layer_repeat,
+        }
+        recorder = None
+        try:
+            if source_work or self.native_analytic_model is not None:
+                from infercast.sdk.diagnostics.prediction_evidence import (
+                    capture_prediction_evidence,
+                )
+                from infercast.sdk.native_segment_module import OP
+
+                options = {}
+                if source_work:
+                    options.update(
+                        source_work_policy=self.native_source_work_policy,
+                        source_policy=self.native_source_policy,
+                    )
+                if self.native_analytic_model is not None:
+                    options["analytic_model"] = self.native_analytic_model
+                with capture_prediction_evidence() as recorder:
+                    result = evaluate_phase_composition(
+                        self.database,
+                        nodes,
+                        getattr(graph, graph_phase + "_composition"),
+                        **evaluation,
+                        operation_kwargs={OP: options},
+                    )
+            else:
+                result = evaluate_phase_composition(
+                    self.database,
+                    nodes,
+                    getattr(graph, graph_phase + "_composition"),
+                    **evaluation,
+                )
+        except PerfDataNotAvailableError as error:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable", f"missing qualified DSPark cost for phase: {phase}"
+            ) from error
+        source_work_evidence = None
+        if result.source == "empirical" and source_work and recorder is not None:
+            source_work_evidence = _source_work_query_evidence(
+                recorder,
+                point=point,
+                phase=graph_phase,
+                policy=self.native_source_work_policy,
+                source_policy=self.native_source_policy,
+            )
+        elif result.source != "silicon" and not (
+            result.source == "sol" and self.native_analytic_model is not None
+        ):
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable", "DSPark requires measured silicon cost provenance"
+            )
+        identity_fields = {
+            "phase": phase,
+            "runtime": point,
+            "slice": str(self.database.slice_ref.slice_dir),
+        }
+        if source_work:
+            identity_fields["native_source_work_policy"] = (
+                self.native_source_work_policy
+            )
+        if source_work_evidence is not None:
+            identity_fields["source_work_query"] = source_work_evidence
+        seconds = float(result) / 1000
+        if self.native_analytic_model is not None:
+            query = _native_cost_query_evidence(
+                recorder,
+                point=point,
+                phase=graph_phase,
+                source=result.source,
+                model=self.native_analytic_model,
+            )
+            identity_fields["native_cost_query"] = query
+            record = {
+                "event": "predicted_phase_cost",
+                "forward_id": step.forward_id,
+                "request_ids_by_attention_dp": [
+                    [request.rid for request in group.requests] for group in step.groups
+                ],
+                "phase": phase,
+                "source": result.source,
+                "seconds": seconds,
+                "identity": identity_fields,
+            }
+            line = (
+                json.dumps(
+                    record, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False
+                ).encode("utf-8")
+                + b"\n"
+            )
+            cost = DSparkPhaseCost(
+                phase, seconds, "umd:" + hashlib.sha256(line).hexdigest()
+            )
+            self._write_cost_line(line)
+            counts = self._cost_counts.setdefault(
+                (phase, result.source),
+                {"phase": phase, "source": result.source, "queries": 0, "seconds": 0.0},
+            )
+            counts["queries"] += 1
+            counts["seconds"] += seconds
+            return cost
+        identity = json.dumps(
+            identity_fields,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        )
+        return DSparkPhaseCost(
+            phase,
+            seconds,
+            "umd:" + hashlib.sha256(identity.encode()).hexdigest(),
+        )
+
+    def predict_step(self, step):
+        if hasattr(self, "_native_joint"):
+            return self._predict_joint_step(step)
+        missing = [
+            phase for phase in step.required_phases if phase not in self.preparers
+        ]
+        if missing:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable",
+                "DSPark full worker costs are incomplete",
+                missing_worker_phases=missing,
+            )
+        return DSparkStepTiming(
+            step.forward_id,
+            tuple(self.query_phase(phase, step) for phase in step.required_phases),
+        ).validate_for(step)
+
+    def _predict_joint_step(self, step):
+        from infercast.sdk.diagnostics.prediction_evidence import (
+            capture_prediction_evidence,
+        )
+        from infercast.sdk.models.umd.description import (
+            bind_runtime_point,
+            build_model_description,
+        )
+        from infercast.sdk.models.umd.executor import evaluate_phase_composition
+        from infercast.sdk.models.umd.templates.deepseek_v41 import (
+            prepare_deepseek_v41_forward,
+        )
+        from infercast.sdk.native_joint_forward import NativeJointForwardQuery
+        from infercast.sdk.perf_database.database import PerfDataNotAvailableError
+        from infercast.sdk.perf_database.dsv41_native_forward import MODEL, OP
+        from sglang_simulator.simulation.sglang.dspark import DSparkStep, DSparkTopology
+
+        policy, runtime, profiles, models = self._native_joint
+        if type(step) is not DSparkStep:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "invalid_dspark_step", "joint cost requires a typed step"
+            )
+        modes = {group.forward_mode for group in step.groups} - {"IDLE"}
+        if not (
+            step.topology == DSparkTopology(2, 2)
+            and step.runtime_profile_json == runtime
+            and modes in ({"EXTEND"}, {"TARGET_VERIFY"})
+        ):
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "invalid_dspark_step",
+                "joint cost requires the complete matching DP step",
+            )
+        mode = "EXTEND" if modes == {"EXTEND"} else "DECODE"
+        profile = profiles[mode]
+        try:
+            inputs = [json.loads(group.execution_json) for group in step.groups]
+            if not all(
+                type(value) is dict
+                and set(value)
+                == {"native_joint_forward_query", "native_joint_source_identity_sha256"}
+                and value == inputs[0]
+                and value["native_joint_source_identity_sha256"]
+                == policy.source_identity_sha256
+                for value in inputs
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("joint source/query provenance differs")
+            query = NativeJointForwardQuery(
+                profile.profile_id, inputs[0]["native_joint_forward_query"]
+            )
+            value = query.to_dict()
+            native = query.native_input
+            if value["runtime_profile_json"] != runtime or native.forward_mode != mode:
+                raise ValueError("joint runtime or phase differs")
+            for group, work, recipes in zip(
+                step.groups,
+                native.to_dict()["groups"],
+                native.to_dict()["sampling_recipe"]["per_attention_dp"],
+                strict=True,
+            ):
+                expected_mode = (
+                    "IDLE"
+                    if group.forward_mode == "IDLE"
+                    else "EXTEND"
+                    if group.forward_mode == "EXTEND"
+                    else "DECODE"
+                )
+                if (
+                    work["attention_dp_rank"] != group.attention_dp_rank
+                    or work["phase"] != expected_mode
+                    or work["requests"]
+                    != [
+                        {"prefix_len": r.target_prefix_len, "extend_len": r.extend_len}
+                        for r in group.requests
+                    ]
+                    or json.dumps(recipes, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
+                    != "["
+                    + ",".join(r.sampling_params_json for r in group.requests)
+                    + "]"
+                ):
+                    raise ValueError("joint ordered geometry or sampling differs")
+            query = NativeJointForwardQuery.from_input(
+                native,
+                profile=profile,
+                source_policy=policy,
+                runtime_profile_json=runtime,
+                group_execution=value["group_execution"],
+            )
+        except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError) as error:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "invalid_dspark_step",
+                "joint query is not bound to the complete DP step",
+            ) from error
+        description, point = prepare_deepseek_v41_forward(
+            build_model_description(MODEL, backend="sglang"),
+            mode,
+            native.requests,
+            profile,
+            query.to_runtime(policy),
+        )
+        phase = "context" if mode == "EXTEND" else "generation"
+        graph = description.op_graph
+        options = {} if models is None else {OP: {"analytic_model": models[mode]}}
+        try:
+            with capture_prediction_evidence() as recorder:
+                result = evaluate_phase_composition(
+                    self.database,
+                    getattr(graph, phase),
+                    getattr(graph, phase + "_composition"),
+                    phase=phase,
+                    env=bind_runtime_point(description, point),
+                    layer_repeat=graph.layer_repeat,
+                    operation_kwargs=options,
+                )
+        except PerfDataNotAvailableError as error:
+            raise PredictorError(
+                "data_unavailable", "missing qualified DSPark joint worker cost"
+            ) from error
+        proof = _joint_cost_query_evidence(
+            recorder,
+            query=query,
+            phase=phase,
+            source=result.source,

+def _validate_batch(batch: ScheduleBatch) -> str:
+    mode = batch.forward_mode
+    if mode not in _SUPPORTED_MODES:
+        raise _error(
+            "unsupported_forward_mode",
+            f"unsupported SGLang forward mode {mode!r}",
+            forward_mode=mode,
+        )
+    if not batch.reqs:
+        raise _error("invalid_batch", "provider batch must not be empty")

+    for index, request in enumerate(batch.reqs):
+        extend = request.extend_length
+        prefix = request.past_kv_length
+        if type(extend) is not int or type(prefix) is not int:
+            raise _error(
+                "invalid_batch",
+                "request lengths must be integers",
+                request_index=index,
+            )
+        if extend < 1 or prefix < 0:
+            raise _error(
+                "invalid_batch",
+                "extend length must be positive and prefix length non-negative",
+                request_index=index,
+                extend_length=extend,
+                past_kv_length=prefix,
+            )
+        if mode == "DECODE" and (extend != 1 or prefix < 1):
+            raise _error(
+                "invalid_batch",

+                request_index=index,

+                past_kv_length=prefix,

+def validate_topology(config: SchedulerConfig) -> None:

+        "pp": config.pp_size,
+        "dp": config.dp_size,

+def milliseconds_to_seconds(value: Any) -> float:
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        raise _error("invalid_provider_output", "InferCast latency must not be boolean")
+    try:
+        latency_ms = float(value)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError) as error:
+        raise _error(
+            "invalid_provider_output",
+            f"InferCast returned non-numeric latency {value!r}",
+        ) from error
+    if not math.isfinite(latency_ms) or latency_ms <= 0:
+        raise _error(
+            "invalid_provider_output",
+            f"InferCast latency must be finite and positive, got {latency_ms!r}",
+            latency_ms=latency_ms,
+        )
+    return latency_ms / 1000.0

+def _canonical_dtype(value: Any) -> str | None:
+    if value is None:

+def _sha256(path: str | Path) -> str:

+    with Path(path).open("rb") as file:

+                    ),
+                    execution_profile=self._decode_execution_profile,
+                    **self._runtime,

+            else:
+                latency_ms = self._provider.estimate_ragged_extend_forward_ms(
+                    forward_mode=mode,
+                    requests=tuple(
+                        self._request_shape_factory(
+                            extend_len=request.extend_length,
+                            prefix_len=request.past_kv_length,

+                        for request in batch.reqs
+                    ),
+                    execution_profile=self._execution_profile,
+                    attn_kernel_impl=self._context_attn_kernel_impl,

+"""Explicit DSPark assembly with measured or opt-in hybrid phase costs."""
+
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import stat
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sglang_simulator.time_predictor.base import InferTimePredictor, PredictorError
+
+
+def _require(condition, message, *, code="provider_initialization_failed", **details):
+    if not condition:
+        raise PredictorError(code, message, **details)
+
+
+def _asset(descriptor, name):
+    _require(
+        type(descriptor) is dict and set(descriptor) == {"path", "sha256"},
+        f"{name} requires exactly path and sha256",
+    )
+    path, digest = descriptor["path"], descriptor["sha256"]
+    _require(type(path) is str and bool(path.strip()), f"{name} path must be explicit")
+    _require(
+        type(digest) is str and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", digest) is not None,
+        f"{name} sha256 must be a full lowercase digest",
+    )
+    try:
+        source = Path(path)
+        _require(
+            not source.is_symlink()
+            and source.is_file()
+            and source.stat().st_size <= 64 * 1024**2,
+            f"{name} must be a bounded regular file without a symlink",
+        )
+        with source.open("rb") as stream:
+            raw = stream.read(64 * 1024**2 + 1)
+        _require(len(raw) <= 64 * 1024**2, f"{name} exceeds its byte bound")
+        _require(
+            hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == digest,
+            f"{name} bytes differ from sha256",
+        )
+        return source.resolve(strict=True), raw, digest
+    except OSError as error:
+        raise PredictorError(
+            "data_unavailable", f"{name} is unavailable: {error}"
+        ) from error
+
+
+def _runtime_json(raw):
+    def unique(pairs):
+        result = {}
+        for key, value in pairs:
+            if key in result:
+                raise ValueError("duplicate runtime JSON field")
+            result[key] = value
+        return result
+
+    try:
+        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
+        value = json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=unique)
+        _require(
+            type(value) is dict and bool(value),
+            "runtime profile must be a nonempty object",
+            code="invalid_execution_profile",
+        )
+        canonical = json.dumps(
+            value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        _require(
+            raw == canonical,
+            "runtime profile JSON must be canonical",
+            code="invalid_execution_profile",
+        )
+        return text
+    except (UnicodeError, ValueError, TypeError) as error:
+        raise PredictorError(
+            "invalid_execution_profile", f"runtime profile JSON is invalid: {error}"
+        ) from error
+
+
+def _native_joint_runtime(
+    database,
+    *,
+    source_policy,
+    runtime_profile_json,
+    profiles,
+    analytic_models,
+    model_config_sha256,
+    model_seed,
+    output_token_id=1,
+    cost_evidence_path=None,
+):
+    """Assemble the typed joint library route under the existing predictor owner.
+
+    The caller retains the independent runtime/capture/allocated-source custody.
+    A progress policy attests the local law and mirror observations, not that
+    physical context. Public native factory/clock activation remains guarded.
+    """
+    from sglang_simulator.simulation.sglang.dspark import DSparkSession, DSparkTopology
+    from sglang_simulator.simulation.sglang.dspark_joint_execution import (
+        NativeJointExecutionResolver,
+    )
+    from sglang_simulator.simulation.sglang.dspark_runtime import DSparkNativeRuntime
+    from sglang_simulator.time_predictor.dspark_golden_progress import (
+        SourceGoldenDPProgress,
+    )
+    from sglang_simulator.time_predictor.dspark_umd import UMDDSparkCostModel
+
+    # All preconditions precede any cost-ledger creation. Never default a
+    # missing physical mirror observation to the CPU engine's backend choice.
+    _require(
+        type(output_token_id) is int and output_token_id >= 0,
+        "joint output_token_id must be a nonnegative integer",
+    )
+    _require(
+        type(getattr(source_policy, "reference_needs_cpu_seq_lens", None)) is bool,
+        "joint runtime requires original reference CPU mirror observations",
+        code="data_unavailable",
+        missing_source_facts=["reference_backend_cpu_mirror_policy"],
+    )
+    _require(
+        type(model_config_sha256) is str
+        and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", model_config_sha256) is not None
+        and type(analytic_models) is dict
+        and set(analytic_models) == {"EXTEND", "DECODE"},
+        "joint runtime requires both explicit canonical-model analytic assets",
+    )
+    from infercast.sdk.native_segment_analytic import NativeSegmentAnalyticModel
+
+    _require(
+        all(
+            type(model) is NativeSegmentAnalyticModel
+            and model.model_config_sha256 == model_config_sha256
+            for model in analytic_models.values()
+        ),
+        "joint analytic assets differ from the canonical model",
+        code="incompatible_runtime",
+    )
+    resolver = NativeJointExecutionResolver(
+        source_policy=source_policy,
+        runtime_profile_json=runtime_profile_json,
+        profiles=profiles,
+    )
+    progress = SourceGoldenDPProgress(
+        source_policy,
+        runtime_profile_json=runtime_profile_json,
+        model_seed=model_seed,
+    )
+    costs = UMDDSparkCostModel.for_native_joint(
+        database,
+        source_policy=source_policy,
+        runtime_profile_json=runtime_profile_json,
+        profiles=profiles,
+        analytic_models=analytic_models,
+        cost_evidence_path=cost_evidence_path,
+    )
+    return DSparkNativeRuntime(
+        session=DSparkSession(costs, progress),
+        topology=DSparkTopology(2, 2),
+        runtime_profile_json=runtime_profile_json,
+        output_token_id=output_token_id,
+        reference_events=True,
+        joint_execution_resolver=resolver,
+    )
+
